description: An object value replaced by a later duplicate key is still evaluated
notes: The spec doesn't say what happens when two elements of an object constructor have the same key. hashicorp/hcl evaluates every key and value in order, so an error in a value that a later element replaces is still reported (ObjectConsExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go). An implementation that rejects duplicate keys during evaluation passes too, so the test only tells apart implementations that accept duplicate keys.
